mapper.select: SELECT s.workspace_id AS workspaceId, w.name AS workspaceName, s.can_edit AS canEdit, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM company_share s JOIN workspace w ON w.id = s.workspace_id WHERE s.company_id = #{id} ORDER BY w.name
